sub6003: The story starts with the alarm interrupting my dream about my dog
turn off the alarm and realize it's been a month since the breakup with Adam.
Looking around the room I see the piano in the corner
where I pushed it to forget about the happy times where Adam and I would play together.
I go wash the dishes
and throw away the old food in the fridge
and dump it in the trash.
Then I called my best friend Lex
who congratulated me for the month anniversary of the breakup.
I hang up
and call her back.
She calls me out on my self-pity party
and tells me she's taking me out.
I hear a bang on the window sit up
hear a second bang
and see Lex throwing peanuts M&Ms at my window.
I go meet her downstairs to let her in my apartment.
I remember I hadn't eaten any peanuts since I started dating Adam because he is very allergic
grab the packet of M&Ms and eat some.
Lex and I go upstairs to get me presentable.
I choose my white dress over the red one.
lex then takes me to a salon
and I decide to get a manicure
I'm not very excited at this point.
Lex chose a green nail polish tone for me.
I turn down a suggestion from Lex to get highlights.
Lex has pink and blue highlights.
I'd rather be home.
I sit outside
and get all covered in chalk paint.
Then we go shopping but at the store I see Adam looking like nothing happened
he didn't look sad just normal.
I hide then decide to go talk to him
but he's gone.
I guess we'll get coffee then to the café where Adam and I met.
We arrive at the cafe where a bunch of students are minding their business
I get in line to order
and a guy asks me if I can take a video of him with his girlfriend
he starts singing
and proposed to her.
I think of the irony of this day being the anniversary of the engagement of this couple and my breakup with Adam.
Then I order drinks for Lex and I
and notice the barista is really cute.
His name is Ryan.
Since I had just gotten my nails done I couldn't reach to my wallet at the bottom of my purse
so I ask Ryan if he can reach into my wallet to grab my card.
when handing me the receipt I scratched his hand with my nails
felt really ashamed
and all the emotions overcame
and I bursted into tears.
I go back to my friend Lex.
I tell her what just happened with the barista
then she gets a call and tells me she has to leave.
She tells me to meet her in one hour at her place.
Ryan then gets me my order two specials on the house.
I kill time at the cafe
and when it's time I leave to Lex's place.
She lives in a sorority house.
Her recipe for fixing a broken heart is getting heavy make up on a short dress and go to a frat house party.
At the fraternity Lex meets some girlfriends
one of who tells me in secrecy that Lex never liked Adam for me.
I confront Lex with what I just heard
and she tells me that it was true that she never thought he was good for me
but that she know who is and points at the balcony where Ryan is.
I don't go directly to him but after a while we start talking and the conversations goes on for hours.
I notice I'm having a good time
but it is getting late
and Lex is passed out on a couch.
Ryan offers to help
and we get Lex to her car
Before leaving I thank Ryan
and give him my phone number.
I get into the car
and drive to my apartment.
Get Lex inside
and lay her on the couch.
I go to the closet
and grab a box with memories from my relationship with Adam
I reflect on how all that time could condense into just a box of memories and how a relationship is beautiful with good and bad times.
Think about letting go of the sadness to let room for a new start.
I get up go to the piano
and decide to play
the music starts filling the emptiness inside of me.
Heals my broken heart life goes on.
My name is Emily btw.
The end.
sub6010: The story starts with the protagonist (that seems to be a college-aged girl) waking up to her alarm.
It has been 30 days since she and her ex boyfriend Adam broke up
and she's still feeling from it.
She sits up
and feels something touching her: it's Adam's old teddy bear.
She doesn't remember how it ended up in her bed with her.
She also notices her piano: she used to play it when she was still with Adam
and now it just sits unused in the corner of her room.
She gets up to wash the dishes.
She remembers something
and goes to check the fridge: on the top shelf the Chinese takeout the ordered the day she broke up with Adam is still there.
She takes it out
and confirms that it's expired.
She throws it away.
She receives a call from her dear friend Lex (who is also a college-aged girl).
Lex congratulates the protagonist for the 30 days of freedom from Adam
but the protagonist doesn't like that.
They hang up
and Lex calls again this time being more careful about what she says.
Lex tells the protagonist that she's coming there to take her out.
The protagonist is unconvinced
but goes along with it.
She goes back to her bed while she waits from Lex to arrive.
Lex comes
and begins throwing yellow packets of peanut-flavoured M&Ms at the protagonist's windows to attract her attention.
The protagonist realizes she is in a sorry state
and puts on some sunglasses to cheer herself up.
The floor is covered with snot-covered tissues from her crying for Adam.
The protagonist goes out of the house to meet with Lex
who is waiting by her car.
They talk about the peanut-flavoured M&Ms: Adam was allergic to peanuts so she hasn't had some in a long time.
She and Lex eat some.
Lex says that the protagonist needs a do-over.
They go back to the bedroom
and the protagonist has to decide between a red dress (Adam's favourite) and a white dress.
She goes for the white dress.
They go out
and Lex convinces the protagonist to go to a salon for a make-over.
They go to the salon
and the protagonist decides to let Lex make all the decisions.
This leads to her getting her nails done
but she then refuses to get highlights for her hair.
They get out of the salon
and sit around for a little bit but the protagonist gets pavement chalk all over her dirtying the white dress.
A bird also flies by and poops on her.
The protagonist and Lex decide to go to a clothes shop to remedy the ugly situation.
The protagonist has to choose between a trendy shop which was also Adam's favourite or a more off-beat one.
She goes for the latter wanting to avoid Adam.
However while at the clothes shop they stumble upon Adam himself:
he doesn't see them as they hide behind the rack of clothes in the women's section of the shop.
Adam seems to be shopping alone.
Lex confronts the protagonist
and encourages her not to hide:
the protagonist agrees
and wants to go speak to Adam
but when she emerges from her hiding spot he is nowhere to be seen.
They get out of the shop and go to a trendy coffee shop which is actually where the protagonist and Adam first met.
When the two enter the protagonist takes the familiar atmosphere in: she hasn't been here since the break-up.
A boy from one of the protagonist's classes (Mass Communication) approaches her and asks her to film him with his camera.
She obliges
and films the guy singing a song to his girlfriend
and proposing to her.
At one point during the act the protagonist decides to leave a cute pug outside of the shop
and this is a good choice because it becomes clear that the pug is part of the act: he is let inside
and brings a ring to the boy which he gives to the girlfriend.
Everyone is happy for the new couple.
The protagonist reflects that her break-up "anniversary" coincides with this new couple's engagement.
Lex goes to sit to a table
and starts chatting with an acquaintance while the protagonist goes to the counter to order something for the two of them.
She is moping around but then she notices something new: a cute tattooed barista wearing a beanie.
She tries to get his attention
but at first he's busy tidying up the place so he doesn't notice her.
When he finally does she order two daily specials.
He remarks she doesn't seem the type for the daily special so she orders two lattes instead.
When she goes to pay she realizes she can't really reach for her money inside her purse due to the new nails
so she asks the bartender (whose name is Ryan like many other attractive Ryans such as Ryan Gosling; she sees the name on his name tag) to take the money himself.
He does
and when he is giving the purse back she accidentally scratches his hand with her new nails.
She apologizes
and starts crying.
He gives her some tissue
and says it's no problem a
nd that it's the first time someone has given him a whole purse for payment.
The protagonist's makeup is kind of messy now.
She goes back to where Lex is sat
and Lex instantly notices something has happened.
The protagonist explains what has just taken place.
Lex remarks that Ryan is very cute
then she gets a phone call: she has to go back to her house to submit a school project or else her group would lose 10% of the grade.
She says to the protagonist to come to her place in like a hour.
They part ways.
Soon after Ryan passes by with her order.
They chat for a bit
she apologizes again.
He says that when he used to play soccer he would get routinely roughed up so it's no problem.
She says she's dealing with a rough period of her life.
The coffee tastes like cinnamon
and is just what she needed.
Ryan goes back to the counter
and the protagonist waits around for a while looking outside the shop's windows
then sees that the time is up and she needs to go to Lex's place.
She sees that Ryan is occupied with a large group of customers so she doesn't bother him.
She walks to Lex's place which is in a sorority house not too far from her apartment.
She avoids stepping on a squirrel along the way.
The sorority house has big greek letters on it.
Lex invites her in
and offers the protagonist her make-up expertise.
The results are quite good.
They prep up for a party that evening.
They eventually go to the party.
Lex is immediately swarmed by sorority girls one of which comes to the protagonist and remarks she's Adam's girlfriend.
The protagonist corrects her by saying she's his ex.
The girl whispers she knows a secret: the protagonist wants to know about it
and learns that Lex had never approved of the relationship with Adam.
The protagonist looks for Lex
and finds her playing charades in a nearby room.
She offers herself as volunteer for the game
and is selected by a frat boy.
She plays charades with Lex drawing a squiggly line with a forked tongue for a snake which Lex correctly guesses.
After the game the protagonist takes Lex in another room to talk to her about Adam.
Lex is reluctant
and tries to avoid answering by pointing that the protagonist would be much better off if she got together with Ryan
who's also at the party (on a balcony looking at the stars).
The protagonist goes to talk with Ryan
but she is kind of anxious
and randomly gets scared when a group cheers.
She decides to just sit around with a drink.
After a while Ryan comes to her
and they start chatting.
She spots a tattoo on his wrist
and recognizes the symbol as a Celtic compass.
He is surprised
and asks her if she's studying archeology.
She replies she's studying journalism.
Ryan is very funny
and Lex relaxes and laughs a lot.
Some of the stuff Ryan says is about his dream home in the deserts of Arizona, his fear of needles, and something about the weathermen on TV being some sort of Illuminati.
There's a moment of silence
and they both speak together.
The protagonist says to Ryan to go first
and he asks her for a dance.
They dance for a while
and it's very intimate
they are very close together.
She notices it's getting late
and spots Lex drunk on a sofa.
She says she should take Lex back home
and Ryans offers to help.
The protagonist thinks about Adam and how he would rarely help.
Adam had stopped being a gentleman soon in the relationship.
Together they bring Lex to her car.
The protagonist writes her number on Ryan's arm
and drives back home.
She leaves Lex sleeping on her sofa
and covers her with a blanket.
She goes back to her bedroom
and takes out a cardboard box with various memories from the past including from her time spent with Adam.
She has an epiphany about the beauty of relationships and moving on from the past.
She goes to her electronic piano keyboard inserts her headphones in
and starts playing music.
The end.
